title: Neon and Puddles
description: The wet pavement acts as a giant mirror for a hundred glowing windows. Ready for the night shift, even if only to watch the reflections dance.
altText: The glowing facade of the Friedrichstadt-Palast in Berlin at night, reflected in a wet, rain-slicked street.

title: Glass and Steel
description: The curvature of the Hauptbahnhof roof filters the gray light perfectly. A yellow-faced S-Bahn train pulls in, ready for commuters and drifters.
altText: Inside the glass-domed Berlin Hauptbahnhof, a red and yellow S-Bahn train arrives near commuters and Alstom signage.

title: Graffiti Pink Call
description: Found this decommissioned phone booth holding secrets. Pink permanent marker on the receiver urges the next caller to make that confession.
altText: A detailed street view of a metallic, graffiti-covered public phone booth on a cobbled Berlin street, focusing on a bright pink phone receiver with hand-written messages.

title: Dome by River
description: The Berlin Cathedral stands heavy under a flat, overcast sky. Its reflection is captured in the dark water, separated only by the stone bridge.
altText: A view across the Spree River in Berlin towards the turquoise-domed Berlin Cathedral (Berliner Dom) on an overcast day.

title: Stone and Scale
description: The sheer scale of the columns makes everyone else look like ants. A massive, classical entrance meant to humble you before you even see the art. Grey skies, gray stone.
altText: The classical portico of the Altes Museum in Berlin, viewed from below, with massive stone columns and people climbing wide steps.

title: Dome and Wire
description: The Berlin Cathedral, a masterpiece of green domes, is temporarily caught in a web of construction scaffolding. The gold crosses still catch the light above the mesh. The work never stops.
altText: The Berlin Cathedral (Berliner Dom) building facade and domes, heavily wrapped in modern metal scaffolding against an overcast sky.

title: Grief in Light
description: In the Neue Wache, a single, solitary statue of a mother and her dead son sits beneath a perfect oculus of light. Rain and light meet on the cold floor. A single rose is left on the wet stone. Silence in the stone chamber.
altText: The Käthe Kollwitz sculpture "Mother with her Dead Son" under a central skylight in the bare stone room of the Neue Wache memorial.

title: Feet on History
description: A frame of glass set directly into the cobblestones. Our modern trainers and boots surround the 'Empty Library' memorial on Bebelplatz. A silent reminder of what was burned right here. Our shadows are cast into the void below.
altText: A glass panel memorial for the book burning set into the cobbled pavement, surrounded by the feet of visitors, with shadows visible on the surface.

title: Words in Stone
description: Two heavy bronze plaques embedded in the ground, preserving words where books once burned. A permanent scar on the pavement to ensure the memory doesn't fade into the background.
altText: A top-down view of two bronze memorial plaques with German text set into a cobbled pavement, flanked by visitors' shoes.

title: Brandenburg
description: The Brandenburg Gate emerges from the mist, indifferent to the drizzle. Crowds scatter across the vast square, tiny figures beneath the copper horses.
altText: The historic Brandenburg Gate in Berlin under a grey sky, with people walking across the wet, open plaza.

title: Hotel Adlon
description: The Hotel Adlon stands imposing on the corner, all pale stone and oxidised green roofing. People drift past on the damp paving, catching a glimpse of a different world.
altText: The grand exterior of the Hotel Adlon in Berlin on a cloudy day, with pedestrians walking along the wide pavement in front.

title: Concrete Sea
description: A grid of grey pillars stretches out like a frozen, geometric sea. The sharp angles of the concrete slabs stand in stark contrast to a lone, bare tree reaching for the sky.
altText: A wide view across the concrete stelae of the Memorial to the Murdered Jews of Europe in Berlin under an overcast sky.

title: The Corridor
description: Stepping into the narrow pathways between the blocks. The concrete walls rise up on either side, closing out the city and narrowing the view to a single straight line ahead.
altText: Looking down a narrow, paved path between tall, grey concrete pillars at the Holocaust Memorial in Berlin.

title: The Bunker Sign
description: An information board stands on a patch of scruffy grass and gravel, marking the spot where history ended in flames. Today, it is just a mundane car park surrounded by ordinary flat blocks.
altText: An information sign about the Führerbunker in Berlin, standing next to a gravel car park and residential buildings.

title: Socialist Realism
description: Massive stone pillars frame a colourful mural of idealised workers marching forward. A heavy, imposing piece of propaganda left behind from an era that tried to choreograph the future.
altText: A socialist realist mural featuring marching figures, seen behind a row of large, grey stone columns in Berlin.

title: The Green Trabant
description: A bright lime-green Trabant drives past a preserved section of the Berlin Wall. The tiny, smoky car of the East cruising past the very barrier that used to contain it.
altText: A vintage lime-green Trabant car driving along a wet street past a weathered stretch of the Berlin Wall.

title: The Soldier
description: A giant portrait of a young Soviet soldier looms high over Checkpoint Charlie, his steady gaze fixed on what used to be the American sector. The sky behind him is just beginning to clear.
altText: A large, elevated portrait sign of a Soviet soldier standing above a busy street near Checkpoint Charlie in Berlin.

title: Charlie
description: The iconic white guardhouse at Checkpoint Charlie sits marooned in the middle of a quiet asphalt street, guarded by a neat stack of sandbags. A barrier that once divided worlds, now reduced to a tourist photo stop.
altText: The historical Checkpoint Charlie guardhouse with sandbags in Berlin, situated on an open city street.

title: The Brain House
description: A massive surrealist mural wrapping around a block of flats. A giant brain floats like a hot air balloon over a painted desert, while actual street graffiti takes over the pavement level.
altText: A large, colourful mural featuring a floating brain design on the side of an apartment building next to a city street.

title: Faces of Berlin
description: Dozens of giant, black-and-white portraits pasted directly onto the building facade. Some have peeled away to reveal the brickwork beneath, giving the architecture a very human look.
altText: A building exterior covered in large, black-and-white photographic close-ups of smiling faces on posters.

title: Mobile Home
description: Spotted this tiny wooden pod sitting perfectly on the back of a flatbed truck. A complete miniature room with its own window, parked casually at the side of a busy city street.
altText: A small green wooden cabin structure built onto the back of a white flatbed truck parked on a street.

title: Table Light
description: A simple white candle burning steadily in a brass holder. Escaping the grey drizzle outside for a quiet corner in a dark tavern.
altText: A close-up of a single lit white candle in a brass holder on a wooden table inside a dimly lit restaurant.

title: Tavern 1840
description: Sitting at the counter under a ring of glowing globe lights. The back bar is stacked with traditional German beer signs and rows of bottles under a classic brick archway.
altText: The interior bar counter of Restaurant 1840 in Berlin, featuring rows of liquor bottles, beer tap signs, and overhead globe lighting.

title: The Obelisk
description: A towering concrete monument cuts straight into the overcast sky at Sachsenhausen. At its base, three bronze figures stand in quiet solidarity, a sombre focal point at the end of a long stone path.
altText: A tall concrete obelisk monument with red triangles at a memorial site, viewed from a stone path on a cloudy day.

title: Iron Gates
description: Looking through the cold iron lettering of the camp gate. The words frame a view across the bleak, open assembly ground toward the distant memorial tower.
altText: A view through an open iron gate displaying the words "ARBEIT MACHT FREI" looking onto a wide, empty camp ground.

title: Kulturbrauerei Courtyard
description: An open courtyard enclosed by striking red-brick buildings. The industrial architecture of the old brewery has found a second life, covered in creeping vines, posters, and a black spiral staircase.
altText: A cobbled courtyard in Berlin surrounded by historic red-brick brewery buildings under a grey sky.

title: World Clock
description: The massive metal structure of the World Clock spinning quietly under the night sky at Alexanderplatz. Lit up in warm amber tones, it charts a hundred different journeys simultaneously.
altText: The illuminated World Clock at Alexanderplatz in Berlin at night, with a metal planetary model on top.

title: Fresh Rolls
description: Taking a break from the history walks with a plate of fresh summer rolls. Translucent rice paper tightly wrapping bright prawns, avocado, and crisp greens, served alongside a rich dipping sauce.
altText: A plate of fresh summer rolls containing prawns and vegetables on a table inside a restaurant next to a candle.

title: Brunch Bowls
description: Fuelling up with thick-cut dark toast topped with smashed avocado, perfectly poached eggs, and a scatter of shredded nori. Accompanied by a rich, vibrant tomato soup.
altText: A plate featuring poached eggs on avocado toast with nori, served next to a bowl of tomato soup.

title: Sweet Side
description: Plump croissants dusted with icing sugar alongside a colourful pile of fresh fruit and whipped cream. A sweet contrast to the grey morning outside.
altText: A breakfast plate with icing-sugar dusted croissants, fresh cut fruit, cream, and a small pot of syrup.

title: The Playwright
description: The bronze statue of Bertolt Brecht sits in contemplation outside the Berliner Ensemble theatre. An enduring artistic presence watching the modern city pass by.
altText: A bronze statue of a seated man on a stone plaza in front of the Berliner Ensemble building.

title: Panda Nap
description: A giant panda completely fast asleep on a wooden platform at the zoo. Behind the bare branches, a traditional red and green pagoda frames the lazy afternoon.
altText: A giant panda resting on an elevated wooden structure with a red pagoda in the background.

title: The Giants
description: An Asian elephant with impressive tusks navigating the sandy enclosure on a cool, overcast day. A bit of the wild anchored right in the heart of the city.
altText: An elephant with large tusks walking through a zoo enclosure under bare winter trees.

title: Fraternal
description: The East Side Gallery after dark. Vrubel's iconic mural stands stark against the pavement, a painted relic of a divided history frozen under the street lights.
altText: The famous "Fraternal Kiss" mural painted on a remaining section of the Berlin Wall at night.

title: Reflections on the Spree
description: The river becomes a dark mirror for the city lights and a solitary construction crane. Quiet waterfront blocks sitting still under a heavy night sky.
altText: A night-time view across the Spree River in Berlin, with city lights reflecting on the calm water surface.

title: The Sushi Platter
description: An evening break from the historical walks. A massive spread of rolls beautifully arranged across a raw wooden board, paired with fresh mint cocktails.
altText: A large variety of sushi rolls presented on a rustic wooden board next to two iced cocktails.

title: River Walk
description: Bare winter branches slicing across a crisp, bright blue sky. Following the iron railing along the riverbank as the glass dome of the Reichstag peeks out in the distance.
altText: A riverside path in Berlin with a black metal fence, looking towards the Reichstag dome under a clear blue sky.

title: To the German People
description: Looking straight up at the imposing stone pillars of the Reichstag. The monumental inscription catches the brilliant afternoon sun against a completely unblemished sky.
altText: A low-angle shot of the grand classical columns and inscribed facade of the Reichstag building in Berlin.

title: Misty City View
description: Looking out over the rooftops from a high perch. The Brandenburg Gate sits quietly below, shrouded in a thin layer of morning haze under the pale blue sky.
altText: A high-angle view over Berlin rooftops towards the Brandenburg Gate on a hazy day.

title: X Marks the Spot
description: Jet trails crossing perfectly in front of the bright afternoon sun. A sharp, geometric interception sketched right above the city skyline.
altText: Two white aeroplane contrails forming a large cross in the bright sky above the Berlin skyline.

title: The Dome
description: The massive glass curve of the Reichstag dome slicing through the crisp air. Modern transparency stitched right onto the old stone architecture.
altText: The exterior glass and steel dome of the Reichstag building under a bright blue sky.

title: Mirrored
description: Inside the glass funnel, looking up at a dizzying spiral of mirrors and walkways. Light bounces off every angle, catching the movements of visitors tracking up the ramps.
altText: Looking up at the central spiral mirrored pillar and helical ramps inside the Reichstag dome.
